capabilities: Add and update created/updated timestamp properties automatically on file events
Preview and apply timestamp updates for a folder or the entire vault
Rename timestamp properties with preview, confirmation, and conflict skipping
Fix legacy malformed datetime values in frontmatter
Configure property names, Date & time/Date/Plain text modes, and ignored paths
extras: README repeatedly warns to back up the vault or use version control before enabling the plugin, renaming properties, or running bulk updates, and recommends preview commands first.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically maintain created/updated timestamp properties in note frontmatter as files are created and edited.
summary: Plugin that keeps created and updated YAML frontmatter timestamps in sync with Markdown file creation and edit activity.
